_note: Synthetic individual profiles for PM-UJJWALA-2.0 outcome-equivalence testing (plan Section 6, 'profile test suites'). Mirrors the scenarios in tests/test_gold_schemes.py's PM-UJJWALA section. unit_of_eligibility is 'individual' -- profiles use only 'self', no family_members (matches the existing gold-scheme tests' shape; the evaluator doesn't read unit_of_eligibility itself, only whether quantifiers other than 'self' are used by predicates).

eligible_baseline._comment: BPL woman, adult, citizen, no existing LPG connection -> eligible.

no_category_membership_undetermined._comment: No inclusion-category fact known at all -> undetermined.

sc_st_alone._comment: SC/ST alone (not also a PMAY-G beneficiary) -> eligible; separate categories, not a compound AND.

self_declaration_fallback._comment: 14-point self-declaration route, no other category -> eligible.

not_a_woman_ineligible._comment: Male applicant -> ineligible, regardless of category membership. Exercises whether the extractor actually captured is_woman as a gating AND condition.

minor_ineligible._comment: Under 18 -> ineligible. Exercises whether the extractor captured age>=18 as a gating AND condition.

non_citizen_not_excluded_by_source._comment: Renamed 2026-10-03 from 'non_citizen_ineligible' (facts unchanged). Non-citizen meeting every stated criterion. The gold's citizenship predicate was removed as unsourced -- the source never mentions citizenship -- so this is now ELIGIBLE. Old gold: ineligible. See docs/GOLD_AUDIT_2026-10-03.md section 6.3.
